title: Winter Nights: Nash cannot recall it
summary: Allen asks about 'Winter Nights'; Nash tries to concentrate and Allen stops the machine.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Where the blues came from: Handy, Bolden and early blues

blocks.x: What about Winter Nights? How much of that do you remember? Do you remember any of that tune?
I'm trying to concentrate. I'm talking to you now and trying to think about it and see whether or not.
Well, we'll turn the machine off. Way back down.
